title: Concept: Conan remote configured over cleartext
description: conanfile.py declares a remote URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Recipes and packages cross the network unencrypted, so a substituted recipe runs arbitrary build logic.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.py (conan).
risk: Recipes and packages cross the network unencrypted, so a substituted recipe runs arbitrary build logic.
